sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:62

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:62:1
items.html: From the Emanator and from Keter in great closeness: For there it receives from the new Rosh [head] of YESHSUT, which is Keter, since every Rosh is the phase of Keter, as is known. And afterward, too, when the records of its own Gevurot rise to it, a new coupling is made upon it itself and it receives light from the Emanator. And this is what he says: “And there it can receive the light from the Emanator and from Keter in great closeness,” and therefore it rose above.
